caption: A car speeds past a pile of dry leaves at the roadside, and the leaves are whirled up in its wake and settle again behind it.

sa.check: A pile of dry leaves lies at a roadside.
The leaves are whirled up in its wake.
The car passes first, then the leaves lift, then they settle.

pc.expect: The leaves lift only as the car passes.
pc.fail: They lift before the car arrives; or with no car; or keep swirling long after it has gone.

pc.expect: They drift back down after the car has passed.
pc.fail: They rise indefinitely; or hang; or float away.

pc.expect: They swirl in the direction the car travelled.
pc.fail: They fly against it; or only straight up; or crosswise.
They are rigid; or move as balls; or as one sheet.

pc.expect: One car keeps its number and the leaves are the pile's.
pc.fail: The car duplicates; or leaves appear from nowhere; or the car passes through the pile.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The car's colour and the roadside stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the roadside rearranges; or the leaves change colour.
